criteria.reason: The keyboard row contains Copy Last, Done, and Next buttons.
Done uses flex: 2 while the other buttons use flex: 1, so it is narrower than before.
Each action button has a 48px height, exceeding the 44px minimum.
The previous set’s value for the active field is passed to the keypad and copied into its display and value.
Next switches the keypad state from weight to reps and loads the reps value.
The styles use color and radius tokens, but Done’s white text color is hard-coded.
The action row uses a flexible layout that can shrink, but no mobile-specific sizing or behavior is shown.
The button labels contain no exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all 197 server and 291 client tests passed.
A new test verifies Copy Last calls onChange with the previous value and displays it.
